# 1.0.85

- Rework the private-call demo into a messenger-style call window: full-screen overlay with speaker/grid layouts, active-speaker auto-focus, camera/microphone/screen tray, minimize pill, incoming-call banner, and call history with ring/ringback tones.
- Add host-centric group calls on top of the existing pairwise call API: invite online participants from inside the call, per-participant tiles with speaking highlight, and a live participant count in the title.
- Start and stop capture automatically with the call lifecycle; capture toggles track user intent and are serialized through `createAsyncQueue`, so devices are released when the last leg ends and a busy device cannot double-start.
- Rework the Workboard demo into keyed cards with focus-preserving reconciliation, drag-and-drop between columns, assignee pickers, optimistic moves, and an activity feed derived from replay deltas.
- Give demo rooms a Meet-style tile grid and remove empty rooms after a 30-second grace period.
- Bound the demo server with light guards (upload size/budget/TTL, board size, room count, command rate) and graceful shutdown; every demo port stays in the 3100 range.
- Keep the public library API unchanged; normalize repository line endings via `.gitattributes`/`.editorconfig`.
